title: Three or four headline cards tell the whole arc
text: Two lines each, a punch then the fact; setup -> escalation -> the worst detail or the turn -> the climax or the twist; a number wherever the story has one; the other side's words in quotes. The voice under them plays only the emotional peak. Narrowed/weakened: some days carry no number; cards run 2-3 lines; on advice and issue days the voice plays a practical threat.

source.heading: Candidates from the overnight study (2026-11-23, none confirmed)
